item.summary: Danish Coop Bank lets customers connect AI assistants to their investment accounts through an MCP connection, but the bank says the connection is read-only: it can answer questions about holdings but cannot place orders. Coop Bank's investment service covers shares and funds, not crypto. Kaupr also reports that the Austrian crypto platform Bitpanda is opening customer portfolios to ChatGPT and other AI assistants.
